conjectures.statement: Dynamical Realignment Theorem: For any smooth solution of 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes, near-maximal extensional alignment a_3 = (omega_hat . e_3)^2 >= 0.90 is a dynamical saddle. Alignment decay Da_3/Dt is governed by pressure-Hessian-induced strain eigenframe rotation T_frame = 2 (omega_hat . e_3) (omega_hat . D e_3 / D t), bounding the continuous lifetime of near-maximal stretching to P_3 = int lambda_3 dt <= C_pers ~ O(1).
conjectures.proof_sketch: Follows from vanishing of T_xi at a_3=1 and off-diagonal pressure Hessian torques Pi_13, Pi_23 in the strain evolution equation.
